authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.
NRPN 1024 is printed as "Master Fine Tune" (global) and as "Tuning Fine" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1025 is printed as "Master Coarse Tune" (global) and as "Tuning Coarse" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1027 is printed as "MIDI Clock Mode" (global) and as "MIDI Clock" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1031 is printed as "MIDI Control Enable" (global) and as "MIDI MIDI Control" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1032 is printed as "MIDI SysEx Enable" (global) and as "MIDI SysEx Control" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1033 is printed as "MIDI Out Select" (global) and as "MIDI Out" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1042 is printed as "Aftertouch Response" (global) and as "At Response" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1043 is printed as "Mono/Stereo" (global) and as "Stereo Mono" (program); the first is used
NRPN 1 is printed as "Osc 2 Octave" (program) and as "Osc 1 Sync" (control); the first is used
NRPN 2 is printed as "Osc 3 Octave" (program) and as "Osc 1 Level" (control); the first is used
NRPN 3 is printed as "Osc 2 Pitch" (program) and as "Osc 1 Shape" (control); the first is used
